notes.title: Sackboy: A Big Adventure - March 30th Patch is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello!

We have another update today that includes further improvements to the NVIDIA Reflex and DLSS Frame Generation settings that were added in last two updates.

This update also includes a couple of additional fixings for a known crash issue and to prevent Sackboy being all spooky and turning invisible in the costume select screen... Scarlet would say that it's very unbecoming for a Knitted Knight to pretend to be a ghost!

- Steven

PATCH NOTES
[list]
[*] Further Improvements to the NVIDIA Reflex and DLSS Frame Generation UI
[*] Fixed Default Sackboy Remaining Invisible in the Costume Select Screen
[*] Fixed a Crash When Swapping Controller and Entering the Graphics Settings
[/list]

notes.title: Sackboy: A Big Adventure - March 22nd Patch is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello!

Since our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1599660/view/3687924439773232053?l=english]previous update[/url] at the end of last week, we have become aware of a number of players encountering performance issues from a couple of new graphical additions to the game.

To help resolve this issue, we have added some new toggles within the Graphics settings that will allow you to further customise your experience by enabling or disabling these graphics options.

Upon installing this update, these new settings will be disabled by default, so if you have been running into performance issues since the previous update, then installing this new update should automatically resolve those issues for you.

We apologise for any issues that you may have encountered since last Thursday's update and appreciate you all taking the time to comment with your issues and feedback.

This update should hopefully address those issues and we will continue to monitor the discussion forums for any further feedback.

- Steven

PATCH NOTES
[list]
[*]Added Two New Options Within Graphics Settings
- DLSS Frame Generation
- NVIDIA Reflex

[i]Note: DLSS Frame Generation is Only Available While in Single Player
Enabling 'DLSS Frame Generation' will disable 'NVIDIA Reflex', 'VSync' and 'Framerate Limit'.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Sackboy: A Big Adventure - March 16th Patch is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello!

We bring a new update to you today to add support for DLSS 3 and Shader Execution Reordering for NVIDIA 40 Series Graphics Cards - If you have a supported graphic card and would like to enable this feature, we have included some instructions below on how to do this.

This update also includes some fixes for Sackboy rolling animations, Travel Pod usage and a fix for UI pop-ups showing up when in the loading screen. [i]Those pesky pop ups huh?[/i]

Last week we also released the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2232580/Sackboy_A_Big_Adventure__Casual_Clothing_Pack/]Casual Clothing Pack[/url], the first of our brand-new mixed clothing packs coming to Craftworld.

This pack is a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2232580/Sackboy_A_Big_Adventure__Casual_Clothing_Pack/]free download[/url] and contains an assortment of jackets, jumpers, jeans, boots, piercings, and more... So download it today and give yourself a fabulous makeover to show off to your friends!

- Steven

PATCH NOTES
[list]
[*] Added in Support for DLSS3 and Shader Execution Reordering for NVIDIA 40 Series Graphics Cards
[*] Fixed Sackboy Rolling Animation Getting Stuck in Certain Places
[*] Fixed Sackboy Getting Stuck in the Travel Pod if a Secondary Player Leaves the Game
[*] Fixed UI Pop-ups Showing Up When in the Loading Screen
[/list]

HOW TO ENABLE NVIDIA DLSS 3

[b]Windows 11[/b]
[list]
[*] Enabled by Default
[/list]

[b]Windows 10[/b]
[list]
[*] On the desktop, pressed the Windows Key or go to Start.
[*] Type 'Graphics settings'.
[*] Select the Graphics setting option when it pops up.
[*] Toggle "Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling" to "On".
[*] Restart your PC to enable changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Sackboy: A Big Adventure - February 22nd Patch is Now Available
notes.content:
Hello!

We have a new update today that looks to address the issue that some players have been encountering when playing local co-op that prevents them from using the Travel Pod (Rocket Ship) upon defeating the first boss and being unable to progress further with this game.

Once the update has been applied, if you launch the game, you should now be able to access the Travel Pod normally and progress with the game.

Want to travel to new worlds in style?

Since our last update we have released the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1599660/Sackboy_A_Big_Adventure/]Valentine's Costume[/url].
And we have a brand-new [url=https://twitter.com/LittleBigPlanet/status/1627684502293323778]Gran Turismo Racing Suit Costume[/url] (and Emote) coming this Friday!

So be sure to download these free costumes and show off your stylish threads to your friends!

- Steven

[list]
[*] Fixed an Issue with Sackboy Getting Stuck on the Travel Pod When Restarting the Game
[*] Fixed Various Issues When Interacting With the "Manage Players" User Interface
[*] General Bug Fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Sackboy: A Big Adventure - December 9th Patch is Now Available
notes.content:

You have been asking for them... So you got them!

This update includes the Sackboy T-Shirt, Baroque Costume and Renaissance Costume that were originally released for the launch of Sackboy: A Big Adventure on PlayStation consoles and are now available for Sackboy PC - Just download this update and they will be available in your collection.

Besides these costumes additions, we also have some further performance fixes and some UI fixes for issues reported by the community, along with a number of other general bug fixes to improve the overall experience of Sackboy: A Big Adventure.

And to top it all off...

We also have our brand-new (and still totally free!!) [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1599660/]Emote Pack DLC[/url] containing 6 New Emotes that your Sackboy or Sackgirl can use to impress your friends!

New Emotes:

[list]
[*] Big Love
[*] Boogie Time
[*] Feel The Beat
[*] Jump About
[*] Lollipop
[*] Look At Me
[/list]
We hope that you enjoy all these improvements and the new content added today - And we look forward to seeing your Sackfolk having fun with their new costumes and emotes!

-Steven
